question: The Military Combat Parachute System (MCPS), which successfully carried out a combat freefall jump from 32,000 feet in October 2025, was indigenously created by ______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Defence Research and Development Organisation (DRDO)**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Military Combat Parachute System (MCPS)** was developed by the **Defence Research and Development Organisation (DRDO)**, a premier agency under the Ministry of Defence, Government of India.
 
• MCPS successfully carried out a **combat freefall jump** from an altitude of **32,000 feet** in **October 2025**.
 
• This parachute system is **indigenously created**, showcasing India's technological advancement in defense systems and its ability to meet critical military requirements.
 
• The **MCPS** is designed for high-altitude operations, enabling soldiers to execute missions in adverse environments with precision and safety.
 
• The development of such systems by DRDO highlights India's commitment to **self-reliance** under the **Atmanirbhar Bharat initiative**, focusing on indigenous production of advanced defense equipment.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Defence Research and Development Organisation (DRDO):**

 
 
• DRDO was established in **1958** and is headquartered in **New Delhi, India**.
 
• The organization develops cutting-edge defense technologies and systems, ranging from missiles, combat vehicles, radars, and electronic warfare systems to advanced parachutes.
 
• It operates under the Ministry of Defence and has over **50 laboratories** dedicated to various research areas.
 
• Some of DRDO's notable achievements include the **Agni missile series**, **BrahMos missile**, and **Tejas fighter jet**.
 
 
 
• **High-Altitude Parachute Systems:**
 
 
• Parachutes designed for high-altitude operations enable **combat personnel** to perform missions under extreme conditions such as low oxygen levels and sub-zero temperatures.
 
• Such systems incorporate **advanced materials** to ensure durability, lightweight construction, and precision deployment.
 
 
 
• **Indigenous Defense Manufacturing:**
 
 
• India's focus on **self-reliance** in defense manufacturing is part of the **Atmanirbhar Bharat initiative**, aiming to reduce dependency on foreign suppliers.
 
• Organizations like DRDO, Hindustan Aeronautics Limited (HAL), and Bharat Electronics Limited (BEL) play a critical role in achieving this goal.
 
 
 
• **Applications of Military Combat Parachutes:**
 
 
• Used for **special operations**, reconnaissance, and infiltration missions in enemy territories.
 
• Enables deployment in **mountainous terrains**, deserts, and other challenging environments.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **DRDO's Role in National Security:**

 
 
• DRDO is responsible for equipping the Indian armed forces with state-of-the-art systems to enhance national security.
 
• Its innovations contribute significantly to India’s defense preparedness and global standing in technology-driven military systems.
 
 
 
• **Other Relevant Organizations:**
 
 
• **Bharat Electronics Limited (BEL):** Focuses on electronics for defense and civilian applications.
 
• **Indian Space Research Organisation (ISRO):** Primarily deals with space exploration and satellite technology.
 
• **Hindustan Aeronautics Limited (HAL):** Specializes in aircraft manufacturing for defense purposes.
